Name: Skellar (Skell's Cellar)
Author: skellady
Description:
A mod to make the cellar bigger and cleaner as well as add decorations to it! Decorations can be disabled in the config.json after launching the game once.

[size=5]Installation:[/size]

- Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 
- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]- Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)
- Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder
- Launch the game and enjoy! ﻿

[size=5]Config: [/size]

Allowed values:

- Default will be "decorated", if you would like the cellar to be empty, change it from "decorated" to "empty" in the config.

Downloads.Description: Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6. Unzip into your Mods folder.
